title: Onramp Launches Business Bitcoin Accounts With Two-Person Withdrawal Approvals as Wrench Attacks Climb
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Onramp Launches Business Bitcoin Accounts With Two-Person Withdrawal Approvals as Wrench Attacks Climb The Austin firm rolled out a free company account with named users and second-person withdrawal approvals, plus a higher Treasury tier that splits keys across three institutions. This post Onramp Launches Business Bitcoin Accounts With Two-Person Withdrawal Approvals as Wrench Attacks Climb first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
